guide.summary: 的 links whatever describes a noun to that noun, and the describing part always comes first: owner, adjective phrase or a whole clause + 的 + noun. The idea that makes it click: 的 marks a loose, built-on-the-spot description. Tight, ready-made pairs (我妈妈, 好朋友, 三本书) do without it, and when the noun is obvious you can drop the noun and let 的 stand in for it (我的, 红的, 吃的).

subs.label: Owner + 的 + thing
subs.focus: Decide that an owner (pronoun, name, noun) needs 的 before an ordinary thing, owner first: 我的手机, 老师的办公室. Mistakes: ✗这是我书; English 'of' order (✗办公室的老师 for 'the teacher's office'). Use full neutral sentences; avoid casual topic-style 我手机没电了, where 的 does drop.

subs.label: 我妈妈, 我们学校: 的 usually dropped
subs.focus: Recognise that pronoun + kin/close relation (我妈妈, 我朋友) or own group (我家, 我们学校, 我们公司) normally has no 的, and chains keep only the last 的 (我妈妈的朋友). Mistake: over-extending to things (✗我书). 我的妈妈 is grammatical: never mark it wrong or force ∅ vs 的 there; use judge-correct items and chains.

subs.label: 好朋友 vs 很好的朋友
subs.focus: Decide if an adjective needs 的: bare one-syllable usually none (好朋友, 新书); degree word + adjective (很/非常/最) or two syllables need it (很好的朋友, 漂亮的衣服). Mistake: ✗很好朋友. 新的书 is possible in contrast, so test 'no 的' only in set pairs or after another 的 (我的好朋友). Never use 很多 + noun as an error.

subs.label: Clause + 的 + noun (我昨天买的书)
subs.focus: Build 'the N that...' as clause + 的 + noun, no word for 'that/who'. Mistakes: clause after the noun (✗书我昨天买很贵), missing 的 (✗我昨天买书很贵), 了 inside (use 我昨天买的书). Cover subject gaps (喜欢喝茶的人), object gaps (妈妈做的菜), place/time nouns (我们吃饭的地方). Suits order and rewrite items.

subs.label: 的 with no noun: 我的, 红的, 吃的
subs.focus: Keep 的 when the noun is dropped: 这本书是我的, 我要大的, 有吃的吗, 这是我昨天买的. Mistakes: dropping 的 with the noun (✗这本书是我, ✗我要大), adding an English 'one' (✗大的一个 for 'the big one'). Test with A 还是 B choices, 谁的 answers, and 吃的 / 喝的 / 穿的 as 'things to eat / drink / wear'.

subs.label: Where number + measure goes
subs.focus: Place number/这/那 + measure: owner first (我的两个朋友; ✗两个我的朋友); new item, 一 + measure before the description (一个很好的朋友); 这/那 + measure usually after a clause (我昨天买的那本书). 那本我昨天买的书 and spoken 很好的一个朋友 also occur: put them in alts or glue the tiles, never mark them wrong.

subs.label: No 的 after a measure word
subs.focus: Leave 的 out after number/这/那/几/哪 + measure word: 三本书, 这个人, 一些问题. Mistakes: ✗三本的书, ✗这个的人, ✗一些的问题. Use individual measures (个, 本, 件, 张, 只, 杯, 些). Avoid amounts that describe the noun's kind or size, where 的 is normal: 两个小时的电影, 十块钱的东西.

rules.rule: The owner comes first, then 的, then the thing owned. This works the same for pronouns, names and nouns, and it replaces both 'my / your' and 'X's' and 'of X'.

examples.py: zhè shì wǒ de shǒu jī
examples.en: This is my phone.

examples.zh: 李老师的办公室在三楼。
examples.py: lǐ lǎo shī de bàn gōng shì zài sān lóu
examples.en: Teacher Li's office is on the third floor.

examples.zh: 你看见小王的自行车了吗？
examples.py: nǐ kàn jiàn xiǎo wáng de zì xíng chē le ma
examples.en: Have you seen Xiao Wang's bike?

rules.note: In casual speech people sometimes drop 的 before a thing at the start of a sentence (我手机没电了). Learn the full form first; it is always correct.

rules.rule: With a personal pronoun before a family member, a close relation or a group you belong to, 的 is normally left out. For home, school, company, class and country, use the plural pronoun (我们, 你们, 他们) or 我家.

examples.py: wǒ mā ma shì yī shēng
examples.en: My mother is a doctor.

examples.zh: 我们学校有两个图书馆。
examples.py: wǒ men xué xiào yǒu liǎng gè tú shū guǎn
examples.en: Our school has two libraries.

examples.py: nǐ jiā lí gōng sī yuǎn ma
examples.en: Is your home far from the office?

rules.note: 我的妈妈 and 我们的学校 are not wrong; they sound heavier or more emphatic. The version without 的 is the everyday default.

rules.rule: In a chain of owners, drop 的 after the pronoun and keep it on the last link, before the thing or person you are really talking about.

examples.py: wǒ gē ge de chē shì xīn de
examples.en: My older brother's car is new.

examples.py: tā shì wǒ mā ma de péng you
examples.en: She is a friend of my mother's.

examples.zh: 我们公司的老板很年轻。
examples.py: wǒ men gōng sī de lǎo bǎn hěn nián qīng
examples.en: The boss of our company is very young.

rules.rule: A bare one-syllable adjective usually goes straight onto the noun with no 的, forming a tight pair.

examples.py: tā shì wǒ de hǎo péng you
examples.en: He is my good friend.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī běn xīn shū
examples.en: I want to buy a new book.

examples.py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi rè shuǐ
examples.en: Please give me a glass of hot water.

rules.note: Adding 的 here (新的书) is possible when you are contrasting, 'the new one, not the old one', but it is not the neutral choice.

rules.rule: Once the adjective has a degree word in front of it (很, 非常, 特别, 最, 不太), 的 is required. Adjectives of two syllables normally take 的 too.
rules.pattern: 很 / 非常 / 最 + Adjective + 的 + Noun

examples.py: tā shì yī gè hěn hǎo de lǎo shī
examples.en: She is a very good teacher.

examples.zh: 这是我们这儿最便宜的手机。
examples.py: zhè shì wǒ men zhè r zuì pián yi de shǒu jī
examples.en: This is the cheapest phone we have here.

examples.zh: 我想找一个安静的地方看书。
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī gè ān jìng de dì fang kàn shū
examples.en: I want to find a quiet place to read.

rules.note: 很多 and 不少 are exceptions: 很多人, 很多问题 need no 的.

rules.rule: To say 'the N that ...', put the whole describing clause in front of the noun and close it with 的. There is no word for 'that', 'who' or 'which', and the clause never follows the noun.

examples.zh: 我昨天买的书很有意思。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shū hěn yǒu yì si
examples.en: The book I bought yesterday is very interesting.

examples.zh: 喜欢喝咖啡的人越来越多。
examples.py: xǐ huan hē kā fēi de rén yuè lái yuè duō
examples.en: More and more people like drinking coffee.

examples.py: mā ma zuò de cài zuì hǎo chī
examples.en: The food Mum cooks tastes the best.

examples.zh: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
examples.py: zhè shì wǒ men dì yī cì jiàn miàn de dì fang
examples.en: This is the place where we first met.

rules.note: Even for a finished action, leave 了 out of the clause: 我昨天买的书, not 我昨天买了的书.

rules.rule: When the noun is obvious, drop the noun but keep 的. Owner / adjective / verb + 的 then means 'mine', 'the red one', 'something to eat'.

examples.zh: 这本书是我的，那本是他的。
examples.py: zhè běn shū shì wǒ de nà běn shì tā de
examples.en: This book is mine; that one is his.

examples.py: hóng de tài guì le wǒ yào bái de
examples.en: The red one is too expensive; I'll take the white one.

examples.py: jiā lǐ yǒu chī de ma
examples.en: Is there anything to eat at home?

examples.py: zhè bù shì wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de
examples.en: This isn't the one I bought yesterday.

rules.note: Do not add a word for 'one': 'the big one' is just 大的.

rules.rule: An owner goes before the number and measure word. English 'two of my friends' becomes 'my two friends'.

examples.zh: 我的两个朋友都在上海工作。
examples.py: wǒ de liǎng gè péng you dōu zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò
examples.en: Two of my friends both work in Shanghai.

examples.py: tā de nà běn cí diǎn hěn yǒu yòng
examples.en: That dictionary of his is very useful.

rules.note: Before a number or 这/那 the 的 after a pronoun is often dropped in speech: 我两个朋友, 他那本词典.

rules.rule: When you introduce something new with 一 + measure word, the number comes first and the description + 的 sits right before the noun. With 这/那 + measure word and a clause, the clause usually comes first.

examples.zh: 我昨天看了一部很有意思的电影。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn le yī bù hěn yǒu yì si de diàn yǐng
examples.en: I watched a very interesting film yesterday.

examples.zh: 我有一个会说中文的同事。
examples.py: wǒ yǒu yī gè huì shuō zhōng wén de tóng shì
examples.en: I have a colleague who can speak Chinese.

examples.zh: 我昨天买的那本书在桌子上。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de nà běn shū zài zhuō zi shàng
examples.en: That book I bought yesterday is on the table.

rules.note: 那本我昨天买的书 is also correct, just less common than 我昨天买的那本书.

rules.rule: Number, 这, 那, 几 or 哪 + measure word attaches directly to the noun. Never put 的 after the measure word.
rules.pattern: Number / 这 / 那 + Measure + Noun

examples.py: wǒ mǎi le sān běn shū
examples.en: I bought three books.

examples.py: zhè ge rén wǒ bù rèn shi
examples.en: I don't know this person.

examples.py: wǒ yǒu yī xiē wèn tí xiǎng wèn nǐ
examples.en: I have some questions I'd like to ask you.

rules.note: An amount that describes what kind of thing it is does take 的: 两个小时的电影 (a two-hour film), 十块钱的东西 (something costing ten yuan).

contrasts.why: Dropping 的 after a pronoun is for family and institutions, not for things. A thing you own needs 的.

right.py: tā shì yī gè hěn hǎo de lǎo shī
right.en: She is a very good teacher.

contrasts.why: 好老师 works without 的, but 很 + adjective is a phrase, and a phrase must be linked to the noun with 的.

right.py: wǒ mǎi le sān běn shū

contrasts.why: A measure word is already the link between the number and the noun. Nothing goes between them.

right.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shū hěn guì
right.en: The book I bought yesterday was expensive.

contrasts.why: English puts 'that I bought yesterday' after the noun. Chinese puts the whole clause before the noun and closes it with 的.

right.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shū hěn guì
right.en: The book I bought yesterday was expensive.

contrasts.why: Without 的 this reads as 'I bought books yesterday' followed by a stray 'very expensive'. 的 is what turns the clause into a description of 书.

right.py: zhè ge shǒu jī bù shì wǒ de

contrasts.why: Without 的 the sentence says 'this phone is not me'. 'Mine' is 我的: the noun can go, 的 cannot.

right.py: wǒ de liǎng gè péng you lái le

contrasts.why: 'Two of my friends' is not built in English order. The owner goes first, then number + measure word, then the noun.
的 already stands in for the missing noun, so 大的 is 'the big one'. No extra word for 'one' is added.
这 + measure word points directly at the noun, just like a number + measure word. No 的 after 个.

cheat: Whatever describes the noun goes before it; 的 closes the description. Never put a clause after the noun.
Pronoun + family or your own school / company / home: skip 的 (我妈妈, 我们学校). Pronoun + thing: keep it (我的书).
One-syllable adjective alone: no 的 (好朋友). See 很 / 非常 / 最 or a two-syllable adjective: add 的.
A verb or a whole clause before a noun? It must end in 的: 我昨天买的书.
Right after a measure word (三本, 这个, 一些): no 的.
Noun left out? Keep 的: 我的, 红的, 吃的.
Owner before the number (我的两个朋友); 一个 before the description (一个很好的朋友).

items.q: 那是李老师___自行车，不是我的。
items.zh: 那是李老师的自行车，不是我的。
items.py: nà shì lǐ lǎo shī de zì xíng chē bú shì wǒ de
items.en: That is Teacher Li's bike, not mine.
items.why: A named owner before an ordinary thing needs 的: 李老师的自行车. Leaving it out gives no normal phrase, and 得 is a different de that follows verbs.

items.q: 你看见小王___书包了吗？
items.zh: 你看见小王的书包了吗？
items.py: nǐ kàn jiàn xiǎo wáng de shū bāo le ma
items.en: Have you seen Xiao Wang's school bag?
items.why: Owner + 的 + thing: 小王的书包. Without 的 the owner and the bag do not link, and 地 only attaches to adverbs before a verb.

items.q: 请告诉我你___地址和电话号码。
items.zh: 请告诉我你的地址和电话号码。
items.py: qǐng gào su wǒ nǐ de dì zhǐ hé diàn huà hào mǎ
items.en: Please tell me your address and phone number.
items.why: A pronoun before an ordinary thing such as an address takes 的: 你的地址. 们 would make 'you (plural)', which is not the meaning here.

items.q: 邻居___狗每天早上都在门口叫。
items.zh: 邻居的狗每天早上都在门口叫。
items.py: lín ju de gǒu měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu zài mén kǒu jiào
items.en: The neighbour's dog barks at the door every morning.
items.why: Noun owner + 的 + thing: 邻居的狗. A neighbour is not kin or a group you belong to, so 的 cannot be dropped.

items.q: 出租车司机___名字我没记住。
items.zh: 出租车司机的名字我没记住。
items.py: chū zū chē sī jī de míng zi wǒ méi jì zhù
items.en: I did not remember the taxi driver's name.
items.why: Owner first, then 的, then the thing owned: 司机的名字. 地 marks an adverb and does not link an owner to a noun.

items.q: 老板___办公室在三楼，他今天出差了，你下午再来吧。
items.zh: 老板的办公室在三楼，他今天出差了，你下午再来吧。
items.py: lǎo bǎn de bàn gōng shì zài sān lóu tā jīn tiān chū chāi le nǐ xià wǔ zài lái ba
items.en: The boss's office is on the third floor, but he is away on business today, so come back this afternoon.
items.why: Owner + 的 + place: 老板的办公室. 得 follows verbs and 地 goes before verbs, so neither can link a person to a noun.

items.q: 我___学校有两个图书馆。
items.zh: 我们学校有两个图书馆。
items.py: wǒ men xué xiào yǒu liǎng gè tú shū guǎn
items.en: Our school has two libraries.
items.why: For a school you belong to, say 我们学校: plural pronoun, no 的. 个 is a measure word and 了 marks a change; neither can follow 我 here.

items.q: 我___公司有五百个人。
items.zh: 我们公司有五百个人。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī yǒu wǔ bǎi gè rén
items.en: Our company has five hundred people.
items.why: A company you belong to is 我们公司, plural pronoun and no 的. 个 is a measure word and 了 marks a change; neither can follow 我 here.

items.q: 这是我妈妈___朋友。
items.zh: 这是我妈妈的朋友。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ mā ma de péng you
items.en: This is a friend of my mother's.
items.why: In a chain only the last link keeps 的: 我妈妈的朋友. Without 的 the chain is incomplete, and 们 would make the mother plural.

items.q: 我哥哥___车是新的。
items.zh: 我哥哥的车是新的。
items.py: wǒ gē ge de chē shì xīn de
items.en: My older brother's car is new.
items.why: The pronoun drops 的 before 哥哥, but the last link before 车 keeps it: 我哥哥的车. Dropping it would glue 哥哥 and 车 together wrongly.

items.q: 我姐姐___男朋友在银行工作。
items.zh: 我姐姐的男朋友在银行工作。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie de nán péng you zài yín háng gōng zuò
items.en: My older sister's boyfriend works at a bank.
items.why: Pronoun + kin has no 的, but kin + the person described needs it: 我姐姐的男朋友. 们 is not needed because there is one sister.

items.q: 我奶奶___邻居昨天送来了一篮子苹果，我们全家都很感谢她。
items.zh: 我奶奶的邻居昨天送来了一篮子苹果，我们全家都很感谢她。
items.py: wǒ nǎi nai de lín ju zuó tiān sòng lái le yī lán zi píng guǒ wǒ men quán jiā dōu hěn gǎn xiè tā
items.en: My grandmother's neighbour brought a basket of apples yesterday, and our whole family is grateful to her.
items.why: Chain of owners: 我 + 奶奶 drops 的, but 奶奶 + 邻居 keeps it: 我奶奶的邻居. The last link before the noun always carries 的.

items.q: 她是一个很好___老师。
items.zh: 她是一个很好的老师。
items.py: tā shì yí gè hěn hǎo de lǎo shī
items.en: She is a very good teacher.
items.why: Once 很 stands before the adjective it is a phrase, and a phrase needs 的 before the noun: 很好的老师. Bare 好老师 would not take 很.

items.q: 这是我们这儿最大___超市。
items.zh: 这是我们这儿最大的超市。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ men zhè r zuì dà de chāo shì
items.en: This is the biggest supermarket here.
items.why: 最 + adjective is a phrase, so 的 is required: 最大的超市. Without it the degree word has nothing linking it to 超市.

items.q: 我想找一个很安静___地方看书。
items.zh: 我想找一个很安静的地方看书。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yí gè hěn ān jìng de dì fang kàn shū
items.en: I want to find a very quiet place to read.
items.why: 很安静 is a degree word + two-syllable adjective, so 的 links it to 地方. 地 attaches to adverbs before verbs, not to nouns.

items.q: 这是这条街上最贵___饭店。
items.zh: 这是这条街上最贵的饭店。
items.py: zhè shì zhè tiáo jiē shàng zuì guì de fàn diàn
items.en: This is the most expensive restaurant on this street.
items.why: 最贵 describes the noun, so 的 must close it: 最贵的饭店. 得 follows verbs and cannot join an adjective to a noun.

items.q: 妈妈买了一张非常漂亮___桌布。
items.zh: 妈妈买了一张非常漂亮的桌布。
items.py: mā ma mǎi le yī zhāng fēi cháng piào liang de zhuō bù
items.en: Mum bought a very pretty tablecloth.
items.why: 非常漂亮 is a degree word plus a two-syllable adjective, so 的 is required before 桌布. 地 would turn it into an adverb.

items.q: 我们住在一个干净又安静___小区。
items.zh: 我们住在一个干净又安静的小区。
items.py: wǒ men zhù zài yí gè gān jìng yòu ān jìng de xiǎo qū
items.en: We live in a clean and quiet neighbourhood.
items.why: A list of adjectives joined by 又 is a phrase and needs 的 before the noun: 干净又安静的小区. Bare adjectives joined by 又 cannot attach directly.

items.q: 爸爸给我们做了很辣___菜，我吃不了。
items.zh: 爸爸给我们做了很辣的菜，我吃不了。
items.py: bà ba gěi wǒ men zuò le hěn là de cài wǒ chī bù liǎo
items.en: Dad made a very spicy dish for us and I cannot eat it.
items.why: 很辣 is degree word + adjective, so 的 links it to 菜. 得 would follow the verb 做, not precede the noun.

items.q: 这是一条人很多、车也很多___马路，过马路的时候一定要小心。
items.zh: 这是一条人很多、车也很多的马路，过马路的时候一定要小心。
items.py: zhè shì yī tiáo rén hěn duō chē yě hěn duō de mǎ lù guò mǎ lù de shí hou yí dìng yào xiǎo xīn
items.en: This is a road with lots of people and lots of cars, so be careful when you cross.
items.why: A whole description (人很多、车也很多) before a noun must end in 的: ...的马路. Without it the clause does not attach to 马路.

items.q: 他是一个热情又有耐心___邻居，经常帮奶奶拿东西。
items.zh: 他是一个热情又有耐心的邻居，经常帮奶奶拿东西。
items.py: tā shì yí gè rè qíng yòu yǒu nài xīn de lín ju jīng cháng bāng nǎi nai ná dōng xi
items.en: He is a warm and patient neighbour who often carries things for Grandma.
items.why: A pair of descriptions joined by 又 forms a phrase, so 的 comes before 邻居. 地 only goes before verbs.

items.q: 妈妈做___菜最好吃。
items.zh: 妈妈做的菜最好吃。
items.py: mā ma zuò de cài zuì hǎo chī
items.en: The food Mum cooks tastes the best.
items.why: A verb phrase before a noun must end in 的: 妈妈做的菜. Putting 了 there would not link 做 to 菜.

items.q: 我昨天买___书很贵。
items.zh: 我昨天买的书很贵。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shū hěn guì
items.en: The book I bought yesterday was expensive.
items.why: Clause + 的 + noun: 我昨天买的书. Without 的 the clause is not turned into a description of 书, and 过 means 'ever bought'.

items.q: 喜欢喝茶___人很多。
items.zh: 喜欢喝茶的人很多。
items.py: xǐ huan hē chá de rén hěn duō
items.en: Many people like drinking tea.
items.why: The verb phrase 喜欢喝茶 describes 人, so it ends in 的. 了 or 地 would not join it to the noun.

items.q: 我们吃饭___地方在学校旁边。
items.zh: 我们吃饭的地方在学校旁边。
items.py: wǒ men chī fàn de dì fang zài xué xiào páng biān
items.en: The place where we eat is next to the school.
items.why: Clause + 的 + 地方 gives 'the place where...': 我们吃饭的地方. There is no word for 'where' in this pattern.

items.q: 这是我奶奶小时候住___房子。
items.zh: 这是我奶奶小时候住的房子。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ nǎi nai xiǎo shí hou zhù de fáng zi
items.en: This is the house my grandmother lived in as a child.
items.why: A clause describing 房子 must end in 的: 小时候住的房子. 住过房子 would stop at 'lived in a house' and leave 这是 without a noun phrase.

items.q: 我想找一个能一起练习口语___同学。
items.zh: 我想找一个能一起练习口语的同学。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yí gè néng yì qǐ liàn xí kǒu yǔ de tóng xué
items.en: I want to find a classmate I can practise speaking with.
items.why: The clause 能一起练习口语 describes 同学 and ends in 的. 得 is the complement marker that follows verbs and cannot do this.

items.q: 坐在沙发上看电视___那个人是我爸爸。
items.zh: 坐在沙发上看电视的那个人是我爸爸。
items.py: zuò zài shā fā shàng kàn diàn shì de nà ge rén shì wǒ bà ba
items.en: The person sitting on the sofa watching TV is my dad.
items.why: The whole clause goes before 那个人 and ends in 的. 着 or 了 would leave a bare verb phrase with no link to 人.

items.q: 从地铁站到我家___路不太远。
items.zh: 从地铁站到我家的路不太远。
items.py: cóng dì tiě zhàn dào wǒ jiā de lù bù tài yuǎn
items.en: The way from the metro station to my home is not very far.
items.why: A phrase before a noun takes 的: 从地铁站到我家的路. 地 is for adverbs, and 了 marks an event, not a description.

items.q: 去图书馆___公共汽车在哪儿坐？
items.zh: 去图书馆的公共汽车在哪儿坐？
items.py: qù tú shū guǎn de gōng gòng qì chē zài nǎ r zuò
items.en: Where do I catch the bus that goes to the library?
items.why: 去图书馆 describes the bus, so it ends in 的: 去图书馆的公共汽车. Without 的 it would read as a separate action.

items.q: 我昨天在商店门口遇到___人是你哥哥以前的同学。
items.zh: 我昨天在商店门口遇到的人是你哥哥以前的同学。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài shāng diàn mén kǒu yù dào de rén shì nǐ gē ge yǐ qián de tóng xué
items.en: The person I met at the shop door yesterday was your brother's former classmate.
items.why: The clause 我昨天在商店门口遇到 ends in 的 and sits before 人. 了 or 过 would leave the clause unlinked to 人.

items.q: 我们刚搬进去___那套房子离地铁站只有五分钟。
items.zh: 我们刚搬进去的那套房子离地铁站只有五分钟。
items.py: wǒ men gāng bān jìn qù de nà tào fáng zi lí dì tiě zhàn zhǐ yǒu wǔ fēn zhōng
items.en: The flat we just moved into is only five minutes from the metro station.
items.why: 搬进去的 describes 那套房子: clause + 的 + noun. 地 goes before verbs, and 了 would leave 搬进去 as a separate verb.

items.q: 这本书是我___，那本是他的。
items.zh: 这本书是我的，那本是他的。
items.py: zhè běn shū shì wǒ de nà běn shì tā de
items.en: This book is mine; that one is his.
items.why: With the noun understood, 的 stands in for it: 我的 means 'mine'. 这本书是我 would say 'this book is me'.

items.q: 这件衣服太小了，我要大___。
items.zh: 这件衣服太小了，我要大的。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu tài xiǎo le wǒ yào dà de
items.en: This piece of clothing is too small; I want the bigger one.
items.why: 大的 means 'the big one'; 的 stands for the missing noun. An English-style 'one' is not added, and bare 大 cannot be an object.

items.q: 冰箱里有吃___吗？
items.zh: 冰箱里有吃的吗？
items.py: bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu chī de ma
items.en: Is there anything to eat in the fridge?
items.why: Verb + 的 turns the verb into a thing: 吃的 is 'something to eat'. 地 and 得 do not make nouns.

items.q: 这个杯子是谁___？
items.zh: 这个杯子是谁的？
items.py: zhè ge bēi zi shì shéi de
items.en: Whose cup is this?
items.why: 'Whose' is 谁的, and 的 keeps the meaning of an owner. 谁 alone would ask 'who is this cup', and 们 does not fit a singular question.

items.q: 这不是我昨天买___，是姐姐买的。
items.zh: 这不是我昨天买的，是姐姐买的。
items.py: zhè bú shì wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shì jiě jie mǎi de
items.en: This is not the one I bought yesterday; my sister bought it.
items.why: 我昨天买的 means 'the one I bought yesterday', with the noun dropped but 的 kept. 买了 would end the clause without a noun to point to.

items.q: 外面很冷，你带点穿___吧。
items.zh: 外面很冷，你带点穿的吧。
items.py: wài miàn hěn lěng nǐ dài diǎn chuān de ba
items.en: It's cold outside, so bring something to wear.
items.why: Verb + 的 means 'something to wear': 穿的. 着 or 了 would leave 穿 as a bare verb with nothing for 带点 to carry.

items.q: 我的手机没电了，可以用你___吗？
items.zh: 我的手机没电了，可以用你的吗？
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi diàn le kě yǐ yòng nǐ de ma
items.en: My phone is out of power; may I use yours?
items.why: Owner + 的 means 'yours': 你的. 用你 would mean 'use you', so the possessive 的 must stay when the noun is dropped.

items.q: 沙发上的书，红皮的是我的，蓝皮___是姐姐的。
items.zh: 沙发上的书，红皮的是我的，蓝皮的是姐姐的。
items.py: shā fā shàng de shū hóng pí de shì wǒ de lán pí de shì jiě jie de
items.en: Of the books on the sofa, the red-covered one is mine and the blue-covered one is my sister's.
items.why: The pattern 红皮的 / 蓝皮的 uses 的 for the dropped noun, and the second half must match it. 蓝皮 alone cannot be a subject meaning 'the blue one'.

items.q: 我们家的两辆车，白色那辆是爸爸___，黑色的是妈妈的。
items.zh: 我们家的两辆车，白色那辆是爸爸的，黑色的是妈妈的。
items.py: wǒ men jiā de liǎng liàng chē bái sè nà liàng shì bà ba de hēi sè de shì mā ma de
items.en: Of our family's two cars, the white one is Dad's and the black one is Mum's.
items.why: With the noun 车 understood, 爸爸的 means 'Dad's'. 爸爸 alone would say 'the white one is Dad', which is the wrong meaning.

items.q: 我昨天买的___书在桌子上。
items.zh: 我昨天买的那本书在桌子上。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de nà běn shū zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: That book I bought yesterday is on the table.
items.why: A clause + 那 + measure word + noun is the normal order, and the measure for a single 书 is 本. 那些 is plural, and 那本的 wrongly adds 的 after the measure word.

items.q: 我有___会说中文的同事。
items.zh: 我有一个会说中文的同事。
items.py: wǒ yǒu yí gè huì shuō zhōng wén de tóng shì
items.en: I have a colleague who can speak Chinese.
items.why: A new item is introduced with 一个 before the clause: 一个会说中文的同事. 哪个 is a question word and 几个的 puts 的 after a measure word.

items.q: 我的___孩子都在北京工作，只有小女儿在家。
items.zh: 我的两个孩子都在北京工作，只有小女儿在家。
items.py: wǒ de liǎng gè hái zi dōu zài běi jīng gōng zuò zhǐ yǒu xiǎo nǚ ér zài jiā
items.en: My two children both work in Beijing; only the youngest daughter is at home.
items.why: Owner first, then number + measure + noun: 我的两个孩子. 的 never follows a measure word, and a bare 两 needs a measure word.

items.q: 我买了三本___书。
items.zh: 我买了三本书。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le sān běn shū
items.en: I bought three books.
items.why: A number + measure word attaches straight to the noun: 三本书. 的 after the measure word is never used, and 个 after 本 would double the measure word.

items.q: 这个___人我不认识。
items.zh: 这个人我不认识。
items.py: zhè ge rén wǒ bù rèn shi
items.en: I do not know this person.
items.why: 这个 already points straight at the noun, so nothing goes between 个 and 人. 这个的人 is a classic learner error.

items.q: 我家有两只___猫，一只白的，一只黑的。
items.zh: 我家有两只猫，一只白的，一只黑的。
items.py: wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng zhǐ māo yī zhī bái de yī zhī hēi de
items.en: We have two cats at home, a white one and a black one.
items.why: Number + measure + noun takes no 的: 两只猫. 们 does not combine with a number, and 的 after 只 is wrong.

items.q: 请给我一杯___水。
items.zh: 请给我一杯水。
items.py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi shuǐ
items.en: Please give me a glass of water.
items.why: 一杯水 is number + measure + noun with no 的 in between. 一杯的水 would mean something different and unnatural here.

items.q: 我有一些___问题想问老师。
items.zh: 我有一些问题想问老师。
items.py: wǒ yǒu yī xiē wèn tí xiǎng wèn lǎo shī
items.en: I have some questions I want to ask the teacher.
items.why: 一些 works like a measure word and attaches directly to the noun: 一些问题. 一些的问题 is not used.

items.q: 那张___桌子是爸爸买的。
items.zh: 那张桌子是爸爸买的。
items.py: nà zhāng zhuō zi shì bà ba mǎi de
items.en: That table was bought by Dad.
items.why: 那 + measure word + noun takes no 的: 那张桌子. Putting 的 after 张 is the typical error.

items.q: 你想去哪家___饭店吃饭？
items.zh: 你想去哪家饭店吃饭？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ jiā fàn diàn chī fàn
items.en: Which restaurant do you want to eat at?
items.why: 哪 + measure word attaches straight to the noun: 哪家饭店. 的 never follows 家 here.

items.q: 我们家有三个___房间，一个是我的。
items.zh: 我们家有三个房间，一个是我的。
items.py: wǒ men jiā yǒu sān gè fáng jiān yí gè shì wǒ de
items.en: Our home has three rooms, one of which is mine.
items.why: 三个房间 is number + measure + noun with no 的. The later 我的 is a separate use of 的 for a dropped noun.

items.q: 路口那座___大楼是新建的医院，听说下个月开门。
items.zh: 路口那座大楼是新建的医院，听说下个月开门。
items.py: lù kǒu nà zuò dà lóu shì xīn jiàn de yī yuàn tīng shuō xià gè yuè kāi mén
items.en: The big building at the junction is the newly built hospital, and I hear it opens next month.
items.why: 那座大楼 attaches 那 + measure to the noun with no 的. A second measure word such as 个 cannot be stacked after 座.

items.q: 这几天我看了好几部___电影，都不错。
items.zh: 这几天我看了好几部电影，都不错。
items.py: zhè jǐ tiān wǒ kàn le hǎo jǐ bù diàn yǐng dōu bù cuò
items.en: These last few days I watched quite a few films, and all were good.
items.why: 好几部电影 is a number phrase + measure + noun and takes no 的. 好几部的电影 is a wrong addition after the measure word.

items.q: 我买了几件___衣服，打算过年的时候送给爸爸妈妈。
items.zh: 我买了几件衣服，打算过年的时候送给爸爸妈妈。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le jǐ jiàn yī fu dǎ suàn guò nián de shí hou sòng gěi bà ba mā ma
items.en: I bought a few pieces of clothing to give to my parents at New Year.
items.why: 几件衣服: 几 + measure + noun with no 的. A 的 after 件 would not be said by native speakers.

items.zh: 那是李老师的自行车。
items.py: nà shì lǐ lǎo shī de zì xíng chē
items.en: That is Teacher Li's bike.
items.why: Owner + 的 + thing: 李老师的自行车. The owner cannot follow the bike, as the English 'of' order would suggest.

items.zh: 我妈妈的朋友是医生。
items.py: wǒ mā ma de péng you shì yī shēng
items.en: My mother's friend is a doctor.
items.why: Pronoun + kin has no 的, and only the last link keeps it: 我妈妈的朋友. 我的 would be redundant in a chain like this.

items.zh: 去火车站的公共汽车在那边坐。
items.py: qù huǒ chē zhàn de gōng gòng qì chē zài nà biān zuò
items.en: You catch the bus to the train station over there.
items.why: 去火车站 + 的 describes the bus and must precede it. 在那边 stays before the verb 坐; the whole bus phrase may also come last: 在那边坐去火车站的公共汽车.

items.zh: 我的两个朋友都在上海工作。
items.py: wǒ de liǎng gè péng you dōu zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò
items.en: Two of my friends both work in Shanghai.
items.why: Owner + 的 first, then number + measure + noun: 我的两个朋友. 两个我的朋友 reverses the order and is wrong.

items.zh: 我昨天看了一部很有意思的电影。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn le yī bù hěn yǒu yì si de diàn yǐng
items.en: I watched a very interesting film yesterday.
items.why: A new item takes 一部 first, then the description + 的 before 电影. A spoken variant puts 一部 after 的, but 的 never follows the measure word.

items.zh: 姐姐买了几件衣服。
items.py: jiě jie mǎi le jǐ jiàn yī fu
items.en: My sister bought a few pieces of clothing.
items.why: 几件 attaches straight to 衣服. A learner may feel a link is missing, but 的 is never added after a measure word.

items.zh: 这把钥匙是我的，那把是哥哥的。
items.py: zhè bǎ yào shi shì wǒ de nà bǎ shì gē ge de
items.en: This key is mine, and that one is my brother's.
items.why: 我的 and 哥哥的 keep 的 because the noun 钥匙 has been dropped. Without 的 the sentence would say 'this key is me'.

items.zh: 冰箱里有吃的也有喝的。
items.py: bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu chī de yě yǒu hē de
items.en: There is something to eat and something to drink in the fridge.
items.why: 吃的 and 喝的 are verb + 的 nominals meaning 'things to eat / drink'. The two halves can swap places with the same meaning.

items.zh: 我哥哥的朋友住在我们学校旁边。
items.py: wǒ gē ge de péng you zhù zài wǒ men xué xiào páng biān
items.en: My older brother's friend lives next to our school.
items.why: Two kin or group links: 我哥哥 and 我们学校 drop 的, but 哥哥 + 朋友 needs it. The noun 学校 gets no 的 after 我们.

items.src_py: mā ma zuò cài cài hěn hǎo chī
items.task: Join into one sentence: "The food Mum cooks is delicious."
items.zh: 妈妈做的菜很好吃。
items.py: mā ma zuò de cài hěn hǎo chī
items.en: The food Mum cooks is delicious.
items.why: The verb phrase 妈妈做 moves in front of 菜 and ends in 的, so the second clause no longer repeats the noun.

items.zh: 这是我的。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ de
items.en: This is mine.
items.why: Possessive + 的 can stand alone for the noun. 我 without 的 would not mean 'mine'.

items.src_py: wǒ xiǎng yào hóng sè de yī fu
items.task: Drop the noun: "I want the red one."
items.zh: 我想要红色的。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng yào hóng sè de
items.en: I want the red one.
items.why: With the noun 衣服 understood, 红色的 means 'the red one'. 的 stays; no word for 'one' is added.

items.src_py: tā shì gè hǎo lǎo shī
items.task: Make it "a very good teacher" with 很.
items.zh: 她是个很好的老师。
items.py: tā shì gè hěn hǎo de lǎo shī
items.en: She is a very good teacher.
items.why: Once 很 stands before the adjective, 的 is needed before 老师. 很好老师 is the classic learner error.

items.src_py: zhè shì jiě jie de shǒu jī
items.task: Turn it into a question: "Whose phone is this?"
items.zh: 这是谁的手机？
items.py: zhè shì shéi de shǒu jī
items.en: Whose phone is this?
items.why: 谁 takes the place of 姐姐 and keeps the 的: 这是谁的手机. With the noun first, 这手机是谁的 also works.

items.src: 我的朋友的姐姐在医院工作。
items.src_py: wǒ de péng you de jiě jie zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.task: Keep only one 的: "My friend's older sister works at a hospital."
items.zh: 我朋友的姐姐在医院工作。
items.py: wǒ péng you de jiě jie zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.en: My friend's older sister works at a hospital.
items.why: In a chain of owners the 的 after the pronoun is dropped and only the last link keeps it: 我朋友的姐姐.

items.src: 我姐姐昨天做了一个蛋糕，蛋糕很好吃。
items.src_py: wǒ jiě jie zuó tiān zuò le yí gè dàn gāo dàn gāo hěn hǎo chī
items.task: Join into one sentence: "The cake my older sister made yesterday is delicious."
items.zh: 我姐姐昨天做的蛋糕很好吃。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie zuó tiān zuò de dàn gāo hěn hǎo chī
items.en: The cake my older sister made yesterday is delicious.
items.why: The relative clause drops 了 and the counted object, and ends in 的 before 蛋糕. The time word may sit before or after the subject.

items.src: 我在商店里买了一件衣服，衣服很漂亮。
items.src_py: wǒ zài shāng diàn lǐ mǎi le yī jiàn yī fu yī fu hěn piào liang
items.task: Join into one sentence: "I bought a very pretty dress in the shop."
items.zh: 我在商店里买了一件很漂亮的衣服。
items.py: wǒ zài shāng diàn lǐ mǎi le yī jiàn hěn piào liang de yī fu
items.en: I bought a very pretty piece of clothing in the shop.
items.why: The description 很漂亮 + 的 moves in front of 衣服. 一件 normally comes first, though the spoken order 很漂亮的一件衣服 also occurs.

items.src_py: zhè shì bà ba mǎi de chē
items.task: Drop the noun: "This is the one Dad bought."
items.zh: 这是爸爸买的。
items.py: zhè shì bà ba mǎi de
items.en: This is the one Dad bought.
items.why: With 车 understood, the clause 爸爸买 + 的 stands for 'the one Dad bought'. 的 cannot be dropped with the noun.

items.s: 这儿是一个很安静地方。
items.s_py: zhè r shì yī gè hěn ān jìng dì fang
items.zh: 这儿是一个很安静的地方。
items.py: zhè r shì yī gè hěn ān jìng de dì fang
items.en: This is a very quiet place.
items.why: 很安静 is a degree word + adjective, a phrase, so 的 must link it to 地方: 很安静的地方. Without 的 it does not attach to the noun.

items.s: 坐在我旁边人是我同学。
items.s_py: zuò zài wǒ páng biān rén shì wǒ tóng xué
items.zh: 坐在我旁边的人是我同学。
items.py: zuò zài wǒ páng biān de rén shì wǒ tóng xué
items.en: The person sitting next to me is my classmate.
items.why: The clause 坐在我旁边 describes 人, so it must end in 的 right before the noun. Without 的 the clause and 人 do not link.

items.s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī bú shì wǒ
items.zh: 这个手机不是我的。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī bú shì wǒ de
items.en: This phone is not mine.
items.why: Dropping the noun must not drop 的. 我 alone would mean 'me', so 'mine' is 我的.

items.s: 这把伞是我的，那把是姐姐。
items.s_py: zhè bǎ sǎn shì wǒ de nà bǎ shì jiě jie
items.zh: 这把伞是我的，那把是姐姐的。
items.py: zhè bǎ sǎn shì wǒ de nà bǎ shì jiě jie de
items.en: This umbrella is mine, and that one is my sister's.
items.why: With the noun 伞 understood, 姐姐的 means 'my sister's'. Without 的 the sentence says that the umbrella is my sister herself.

items.s_py: liǎng gè wǒ de péng you lái le
items.zh: 我的两个朋友来了。
items.py: wǒ de liǎng gè péng you lái le
items.en: Two of my friends came.
items.why: The owner goes first, then number + measure + noun. English 'two of my friends' cannot be copied in that order.

items.s_py: zhè ge de rén shì shuí
items.zh: 这个人是谁？
items.py: zhè ge rén shì shuí
items.en: Who is this person?
items.why: 这个 already points at the noun, so nothing goes between it and 人. 的 after a measure word is a classic error.

items.s: 我有一些的问题想问你。
items.s_py: wǒ yǒu yī xiē de wèn tí xiǎng wèn nǐ
items.zh: 我有一些问题想问你。
items.py: wǒ yǒu yī xiē wèn tí xiǎng wèn nǐ
items.en: I have some questions I want to ask you.
items.why: 一些 acts like a number + measure word and takes no 的 before the noun.

items.s_py: wǒ de mā ma shì yī shēng
items.zh: 我的妈妈是医生。
items.py: wǒ de mā ma shì yī shēng
items.en: My mother is a doctor.
items.why: Many learners think 的 must be dropped, but 我的妈妈 is grammatical. It sounds heavier than 我妈妈, and the sentence is correct.

items.s_py: tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you
items.zh: 他是我最好的朋友。
items.py: tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you
items.en: He is my best friend.
items.why: 最好 is a phrase, so 的 stays before 朋友. Learners may want to drop it after 好 alone, but with 最 it is required.

items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī běn xīn shū
items.zh: 我想买一本新书。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī běn xīn shū
items.en: I want to buy a new book.
items.why: A one-syllable adjective sits directly before the noun: 新书. 的 is not needed in this neutral description.

items.s: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
items.s_py: zhè shì wǒ men dì yī cì jiàn miàn de dì fang
items.zh: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ men dì yī cì jiàn miàn de dì fang
items.en: This is the place where we first met.
items.why: The clause 我们第一次见面 ends in 的 before 地方. There is no separate word for 'where', and the order is correct.

items.s_py: bīng xiāng lǐ méi yǒu chī de
items.zh: 冰箱里没有吃的。
items.py: bīng xiāng lǐ méi yǒu chī de
items.en: There is nothing to eat in the fridge.
items.why: 吃的 means 'something to eat', with 的 standing for the missing noun. Dropping 的 would leave a bare verb as an object.

items.s_py: tā de nà běn cí diǎn hěn yǒu yòng
items.zh: 他的那本词典很有用。
items.py: tā de nà běn cí diǎn hěn yǒu yòng
items.en: That dictionary of his is very useful.
items.why: Owner + 的, then 那 + measure + noun: 他的那本词典. 的 after 他 is fine, and no 的 follows 本.

items.s: 这是一部两个小时的电影，我们看完要九点了。
items.s_py: zhè shì yī bù liǎng gè xiǎo shí de diàn yǐng wǒ men kàn wán yào jiǔ diǎn le
items.zh: 这是一部两个小时的电影，我们看完要九点了。
items.py: zhè shì yī bù liǎng gè xiǎo shí de diàn yǐng wǒ men kàn wán yào jiǔ diǎn le
items.en: This is a two-hour film, and it will be nine o'clock when we finish.
items.why: An amount that describes the kind of thing, like 两个小时的电影, does keep 的. It sits after 一部, so 的 does not directly follow a measure word.

items.s: 我在公园里认识了一个很会照顾孩子的邻居。
items.s_py: wǒ zài gōng yuán lǐ rèn shi le yí gè hěn huì zhào gù hái zi de lín ju
items.zh: 我在公园里认识了一个很会照顾孩子的邻居。
items.py: wǒ zài gōng yuán lǐ rèn shi le yí gè hěn huì zhào gù hái zi de lín ju
items.en: I met a neighbour in the park who is very good at looking after children.
items.why: 一个 comes first and the long clause + 的 sits right before 邻居. The sentence follows the number + description + 的 + noun order.

items.q: 这是医生___药，不是我的。
items.zh: 这是医生的药，不是我的。
items.py: zhè shì yī shēng de yào bú shì wǒ de
items.en: This is the doctor's medicine, not mine.
items.why: An owner noun before an ordinary thing needs 的: 医生的药. 地 and 得 attach to verbs and adjectives, and 医生药 with nothing between sounds like a compound, not 'the doctor's medicine'.

items.q: 我借了弟弟___耳机，没借妹妹的。
items.zh: 我借了弟弟的耳机，没借妹妹的。
items.py: wǒ jiè le dì di de ěr jī méi jiè mèi mei de
items.en: I borrowed my younger brother's earphones, not my younger sister's.
items.why: 弟弟 is the owner and 耳机 an ordinary thing he owns, so 的 links them, matching 妹妹的 in the second half. 得 and 地 never link a noun to a noun, and bare 弟弟耳机 sounds unfinished here.

items.q: 请把老师___眼镜送过去，他在办公室等着。
items.zh: 请把老师的眼镜送过去，他在办公室等着。
items.py: qǐng bǎ lǎo shī de yǎn jìng sòng guò qù tā zài bàn gōng shì děng zhe
items.en: Please take the teacher's glasses over; he is waiting in the office.
items.why: Owner + 的 + thing: 老师的眼镜. 的 is the only one of these that joins a possessor to an ordinary object; 得 and 地 follow verbs and adjectives.

items.q: 护士___手机一直占线，我打不通。
items.zh: 护士的手机一直占线，我打不通。
items.py: hù shi de shǒu jī yì zhí zhàn xiàn wǒ dǎ bù tōng
items.en: The nurse's phone has been busy all the time; I can't get through.
items.why: The noun 护士 owns the 手机, so 的 goes between them. 护士地手机 and 护士得手机 misuse the other two de's, which belong to adverbs and complements.

items.q: 邻居___路由器坏了，所以他来借我们的网络。
items.zh: 邻居的路由器坏了，所以他来借我们的网络。
items.py: lín jū de lù yóu qì huài le suǒ yǐ tā lái jiè wǒ men de wǎng luò
items.en: The neighbour's router broke, so he came to use our internet.
items.why: Noun owner + 的 + thing: 邻居的路由器. The English 's has no Chinese ending other than 的, and leaving it out makes 邻居路由器 sound like a product type.

items.q: 听说那位医生___诊所在老城区，离地铁站不太远。
items.zh: 听说那位医生的诊所在老城区，离地铁站不太远。
items.py: tīng shuō nà wèi yī shēng de zhěn suǒ zài lǎo chéng qū lí dì tiě zhàn bù tài yuǎn
items.en: I hear that doctor's clinic is in the old town, not far from the metro station.
items.why: The owner is the whole phrase 那位医生, and 的 closes it before the thing owned: 那位医生的诊所. Without 的 the phrase 医生诊所 would lose the possessor meaning.

items.q: 同事___笔记本电脑没电了，我把我的充电器借给了他。
items.zh: 同事的笔记本电脑没电了，我把我的充电器借给了他。
items.py: tóng shì de bǐ jì běn diàn nǎo méi diàn le wǒ bǎ wǒ de chōng diàn qì jiè gěi le tā
items.en: My colleague's laptop ran out of battery, so I lent him my charger.
items.why: 同事 owns the laptop, so 同事的笔记本电脑. A long noun like 笔记本电脑 after a bare owner is not a tight pair, so 的 is needed to mark the owner.

items.q: 医生检查了我爷爷___眼睛，说没有大问题。
items.zh: 医生检查了我爷爷的眼睛，说没有大问题。
items.py: yī shēng jiǎn chá le wǒ yé ye de yǎn jing shuō méi yǒu dà wèn tí
items.en: The doctor examined my grandfather's eyes and said there was no big problem.
items.why: In a chain, 的 is dropped after the pronoun (我爷爷) but kept on the last link before the thing: 我爷爷的眼睛. Here 眼睛 is a body part in object position, so the link 的 stays.

items.q: 护士量了我奶奶___血压，一切都正常。
items.zh: 护士量了我奶奶的血压，一切都正常。
items.py: hù shi liáng le wǒ nǎi nai de xuè yā yī qiè dōu zhèng cháng
items.en: The nurse measured my grandmother's blood pressure; everything was normal.
items.why: The pronoun 我 attaches to 奶奶 with no 的, but 奶奶 + 血压 is owner + thing, so 的 comes after 奶奶: 我奶奶的血压. 得 and 地 do not link nouns.

items.q: 我姐姐___医生朋友告诉我，多喝水对嗓子有好处。
items.zh: 我姐姐的医生朋友告诉我，多喝水对嗓子有好处。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie de yī shēng péng you gào sù wǒ duō hē shuǐ duì sǎng zi yǒu hǎo chù
items.en: A doctor friend of my older sister's told me drinking more water is good for the throat.
items.why: 我姐姐 keeps no 的 after the pronoun, but the chain ends with 的 before the noun 医生朋友: 我姐姐的医生朋友. 得 and 地 cannot link two nouns.

items.q: 医生看了看我弟弟___牙齿。
items.zh: 医生看了看我弟弟的牙齿。
items.py: yī shēng kàn le kàn wǒ dì di de yá chǐ
items.en: The doctor looked at my younger brother's teeth.
items.why: Family member + thing: the 的 after 弟弟 stays, since 牙齿 is a thing owned. Only the 的 right after the pronoun 我 is dropped.

items.q: 她是一个很好___朋友，生病时总是陪着我。
items.zh: 她是一个很好的朋友，生病时总是陪着我。
items.py: tā shì yí gè hěn hǎo de péng you shēng bìng shí zǒng shì péi zhe wǒ
items.en: She is a very good friend; she always stays with me when I'm ill.
items.why: 很 + adjective is a phrase, so 的 is required before the noun: 很好的朋友. 好朋友 without 很 is fine, but 很好朋友 is not. 地 and 得 are for verbs.

items.q: 我想买一部很小___手机。
items.zh: 我想买一部很小的手机。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī bù hěn xiǎo de shǒu jī
items.en: I want to buy a very small phone.
items.why: Once 很 is in front of the adjective, 的 must link it to 手机: 很小的手机. Dropping it works only for a bare one-syllable adjective like 小手机.

items.q: 这是一家非常大___医院，每天有几千个病人。
items.zh: 这是一家非常大的医院，每天有几千个病人。
items.py: zhè shì yī jiā fēi cháng dà de yī yuàn měi tiān yǒu jǐ qiān gè bìng rén
items.en: This is a very big hospital, with thousands of patients every day.
items.why: 非常 + 大 is a degree phrase, so it needs 的: 非常大的医院. 非常大医院 is wrong, and 大得 / 大地 would be a complement or adverb, not a noun modifier.

items.q: 我想找一个安静___地方打电话。
items.zh: 我想找一个安静的地方打电话。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yí gè ān jìng de dì fang dǎ diàn huà
items.en: I want to find a quiet place to make a call.
items.why: 安静 has two syllables, so it takes 的 before the noun: 安静的地方. 地 would make 安静 an adverb, and with nothing at all 安静地方 is not a normal phrase.

items.q: 医生给我开了一些很苦___药。
items.zh: 医生给我开了一些很苦的药。
items.py: yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le yī xiē hěn kǔ de yào
items.en: The doctor prescribed me some very bitter medicine.
items.why: 一些 + 很苦 + 药: the adjective has a degree word, so 的 is required: 很苦的药. 苦得药 and 苦地药 use the wrong de.

items.q: 网速特别慢___时候，视频总是停下来。
items.zh: 网速特别慢的时候，视频总是停下来。
items.py: wǎng sù tè bié màn de shí hou shì pín zǒng shì tíng xià lái
items.en: When the internet is very slow, videos keep stopping.
items.why: 特别慢 is a phrase describing 时候, so it needs 的: 特别慢的时候. 慢得 would introduce a result complement, which this clause does not have.

items.q: 他买了一部又轻又薄___手机。
items.zh: 他买了一部又轻又薄的手机。
items.py: tā mǎi le yī bù yòu qīng yòu báo de shǒu jī
items.en: He bought a phone that is both light and thin.
items.why: 又轻又薄 is a multi-word description, so 的 links it to 手机. Bare adjectives drop 的 only when a single one-syllable adjective stands alone.

items.q: 她是一个认真、耐心、对病人非常温柔___护士。
items.zh: 她是一个认真、耐心、对病人非常温柔的护士。
items.py: tā shì yí gè rèn zhēn nài xīn duì bìng rén fēi cháng wēn róu de hù shi
items.en: She is a serious, patient nurse who is very gentle with patients.
items.why: A long description made of several parts, including 对病人非常温柔, must close with 的 before 护士. 地 would turn the phrase into an adverb of manner.

items.q: 这是我用过的最方便___软件，不用注册就能看。
items.zh: 这是我用过的最方便的软件，不用注册就能看。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ yòng guò de zuì fāng biàn de ruǎn jiàn bù yòng zhù cè jiù néng kàn
items.en: This is the most convenient software I have used; you can watch without registering.
items.why: 最 + adjective needs 的 before the noun: 最方便的软件. The earlier 的 in 用过的 makes a relative clause, and both 的 are required, one for each description.

items.q: 我昨天下载___软件是免费的。
items.zh: 我昨天下载的软件是免费的。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān xià zài de ruǎn jiàn shì miǎn fèi de
items.en: The software I downloaded yesterday is free.
items.why: A clause that describes a noun ends in 的: 我昨天下载的软件. Putting 了 there would leave 我昨天下载了软件 as a full sentence followed by an unrelated 是免费的.

items.q: 这是医生给我开___药。
items.zh: 这是医生给我开的药。
items.py: zhè shì yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi de yào
items.en: This is the medicine the doctor prescribed for me.
items.why: 'The medicine the doctor prescribed' is the clause 医生给我开 + 的 + the noun 药. There is no word for 'that', and 了 inside the clause would break the noun phrase.

items.q: 喜欢玩游戏___人很多。
items.zh: 喜欢玩游戏的人很多。
items.py: xǐ huan wán yóu xì de rén hěn duō
items.en: There are many people who like playing games.
items.why: A verb phrase can describe a noun: 喜欢玩游戏 + 的 + 人. The clause comes before 人, and 的 closes it. 地 or 得 would turn it into an adverb or a complement.

items.q: 你昨天在网上买___充电器到了吗？
items.zh: 你昨天在网上买的充电器到了吗？
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi de chōng diàn qì dào le ma
items.en: Has the charger you bought online yesterday arrived?
items.why: 'The charger you bought' needs 的 after the clause 你昨天在网上买. 了, 着 and 过 would make 买 a closed verb phrase and leave 充电器到了吗 without a proper subject.

items.q: 医生说，经常熬夜___人容易头疼。
items.zh: 医生说，经常熬夜的人容易头疼。
items.py: yī shēng shuō jīng cháng áo yè de rén róng yì tóu téng
items.en: The doctor says people who often stay up late get headaches easily.
items.why: 经常熬夜 describes the noun 人, so the clause takes 的: 经常熬夜的人. 熬夜得 would expect a result complement, which is not what follows.

items.q: 我们去看病___那家医院可以在手机上挂号。
items.zh: 我们去看病的那家医院可以在手机上挂号。
items.py: wǒ men qù kàn bìng de nà jiā yī yuàn kě yǐ zài shǒu jī shàng guà hào
items.en: The hospital where we go to see the doctor lets you register on your phone.
items.why: 去看病 is a clause describing 医院, so 的 closes it: 去看病的那家医院. The clause comes before the noun and the 那家 stays right in front of 医院.

items.q: 睡觉前看手机___习惯对眼睛不好。
items.zh: 睡觉前看手机的习惯对眼睛不好。
items.py: shuì jiào qián kàn shǒu jī de xí guàn duì yǎn jing bù hǎo
items.en: The habit of looking at your phone before bed is bad for the eyes.
items.why: A whole verb phrase can describe 习惯: 睡觉前看手机 + 的 + 习惯. Without 的 the phrase would sound like two actions, and 了 would add a completed event the habit does not have.

items.q: 修手机___地方在二楼。
items.zh: 修手机的地方在二楼。
items.py: xiū shǒu jī de dì fang zài èr lóu
items.en: The place where they fix phones is on the second floor.
items.why: 修手机 + 的 + 地方 gives 'the place where (they) fix phones'. 地 is the adverb marker and cannot link a clause to a noun; 得 and 了 do not fit either.

items.q: 我每天用来记录睡眠___那个软件，最近突然不能用了。
items.zh: 我每天用来记录睡眠的那个软件，最近突然不能用了。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān yòng lái jì lù shuì mián de nà ge ruǎn jiàn zuì jìn tū rán bù néng yòng le
items.en: The software I use every day to track my sleep suddenly stopped working recently.
items.why: 记录睡眠 describes 那个软件, and the clause closes with 的 before the 那个 + noun. The 了 later in the sentence belongs to the main verb and cannot be borrowed inside the clause.

items.q: 昨天在医院门口遇到___那位老人是我们小区的邻居。
items.zh: 昨天在医院门口遇到的那位老人是我们小区的邻居。
items.py: zuó tiān zài yī yuàn mén kǒu yù dào de nà wèi lǎo rén shì wǒ men xiǎo qū de lín jū
items.en: The elderly man I met at the hospital entrance yesterday is a neighbour from our community.
items.why: With 的 the clause 昨天在医院门口遇到 describes 那位老人. With 了 the clause would be a finished event and 那位老人是…邻居 would have no proper subject.

items.q: 医生让我把最近每天吃___东西都写下来。
items.zh: 医生让我把最近每天吃的东西都写下来。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ bǎ zuì jìn měi tiān chī de dōng xi dōu xiě xià lái
items.en: The doctor asked me to write down everything I have eaten each day lately.
items.why: 每天吃 + 的 + 东西 is 'the things (I) eat every day'. 了 in the clause would not combine with the habit 每天, and 地 or 得 do not modify nouns.

items.q: 这个充电器不是我___，是弟弟的。
items.zh: 这个充电器不是我的，是弟弟的。
items.py: zhè ge chōng diàn qì bú shì wǒ de shì dì di de
items.en: This charger isn't mine; it's my brother's.
items.why: The noun 充电器 is already mentioned, so 我的 means 'mine'. Dropping 的 gives 不是我, which says the charger is not me.

items.q: 这两部手机，大___是我的，小的是姐姐的。
items.zh: 这两部手机，大的是我的，小的是姐姐的。
items.py: zhè liǎng bù shǒu jī dà de shì wǒ de xiǎo de shì jiě jie de
items.en: Of these two phones, the big one is mine and the small one is my sister's.
items.why: The noun 手机 is understood, so 大 + 的 means 'the big one'. 大个 or 大些 would not mean that, and bare 大 cannot stand as a noun here.

items.q: 医生说我不能喝冷___，只能喝热的。
items.zh: 医生说我不能喝冷的，只能喝热的。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ bù néng hē lěng de zhǐ néng hē rè de
items.en: The doctor says I can't drink cold things, only hot ones.
items.why: 喝冷 alone is incomplete; 冷的 means 'something cold'. The same 的 appears in 热的, so the two halves match.

items.q: 这副耳机是谁___？
items.zh: 这副耳机是谁的？
items.py: zhè fù ěr jī shì shéi de
items.en: Whose earphones are these?
items.why: 谁的 means 'whose', and the noun 耳机 is already in the question, so 的 stays. 这副耳机是谁 would ask who the earphones are.

items.q: 我的手机屏幕太小了，我想换一个大___。
items.zh: 我的手机屏幕太小了，我想换一个大的。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī píng mù tài xiǎo le wǒ xiǎng huàn yí gè dà de
items.en: My phone screen is too small; I want to switch to a bigger one.
items.why: 'A big one' is 大的, with 的 standing for the missing 手机. English 'one' is not added again, and 换一个大 alone is incomplete.

items.q: 出门前带点吃___，路上可能会饿。
items.zh: 出门前带点吃的，路上可能会饿。
items.py: chū mén qián dài diǎn chī de lù shàng kě néng huì è
items.en: Take something to eat before you go out; you may get hungry on the way.
items.why: 吃的 means 'something to eat', with 的 turning the verb into a thing. 带点吃 is not complete, and 吃了 would be a completed action instead.

items.q: 这不是医生给我开___，是我自己在药店买的。
items.zh: 这不是医生给我开的，是我自己在药店买的。
items.py: zhè bú shì yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi de shì wǒ zì jǐ zài yào diàn mǎi de
items.en: This isn't what the doctor prescribed for me; I bought it myself at the pharmacy.
items.why: The noun 药 is dropped, so the clause 医生给我开 keeps 的: 医生给我开的 = 'what the doctor prescribed'. 了 would make the clause complete and the meaning changes.

items.q: 这个手机壳不是我买___，是朋友送的。
items.zh: 这个手机壳不是我买的，是朋友送的。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī ké bú shì wǒ mǎi de shì péng you sòng de
items.en: I didn't buy this phone case; a friend gave it to me.
items.why: 不是我买的 means 'it is not what I bought', with 的 marking the clause as a description with no noun. 了, 过 and 着 do not work after 不是.

items.q: 这两种药，我要饭后吃___。
items.zh: 这两种药，我要饭后吃的。
items.py: zhè liǎng zhǒng yào wǒ yào fàn hòu chī de
items.en: Of these two medicines, I want the one that is taken after meals.
items.why: 饭后吃的 means 'the one taken after meals', and 的 stands for 药. Without it, 我要饭后吃 would mean 'I want to eat after meals', which is not the cue.

items.q: 我的手机坏了，用姐姐___吧，她今天不用。
items.zh: 我的手机坏了，用姐姐的吧，她今天不用。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī huài le yòng jiě jie de ba tā jīn tiān bù yòng
items.en: My phone is broken; use my sister's, she isn't using it today.
items.why: 姐姐的 means 'my sister's (phone)'. The noun 手机 is already known, so 的 stays alone. 用姐姐 would mean 'use my sister'.

items.q: 我弟弟买了___很好的手机。
items.zh: 我弟弟买了一部很好的手机。
items.py: wǒ dì di mǎi le yī bù hěn hǎo de shǒu jī
items.en: My younger brother bought a very good phone.
items.why: A new thing is introduced with 一 + measure word before the description: 一部很好的手机. 的 never follows the measure word, and 这部 would make the phone a known one.

items.q: ___朋友今天都生病了。
items.zh: 我的两个朋友今天都生病了。
items.py: wǒ de liǎng gè péng you jīn tiān dōu shēng bìng le
items.en: Two of my friends are sick today.
items.why: The owner goes before the number: 我的两个朋友. English 'two of my friends' tempts you to say 两个我的朋友, which Chinese does not allow.

items.q: 我昨天在医院认识了___。
items.zh: 我昨天在医院认识了一位很有耐心的护士。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài yī yuàn rèn shi le yī wèi hěn yǒu nài xīn de hù shi
items.en: I met a very patient nurse at the hospital yesterday.
items.why: 一位 comes first, then the description 很有耐心 + 的, then the noun. 的 belongs right before 护士, not after 一位, and 很有耐心 needs it.

items.q: 我昨天买的___手机，今天就坏了。
items.zh: 我昨天买的那部手机，今天就坏了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de nà bù shǒu jī jīn tiān jiù huài le
items.en: The phone I bought yesterday broke today already.
items.why: After the clause + 的, 那部 sits directly before 手机: 我昨天买的那部手机. 的 does not come after a measure word, so 那部的 is wrong.

items.q: 你认识___会修手机的人吗？
items.zh: 你认识一个会修手机的人吗？
items.py: nǐ rèn shi yí gè huì xiū shǒu jī de rén ma
items.en: Do you know a person who can fix phones?
items.why: 一个 comes directly before the described noun with no 的 in between: 一个会修手机的人. The 的 that is needed sits after 会修手机, not after the measure word.

items.q: 他给我推荐了___很实用的健康软件。
items.zh: 他给我推荐了一个很实用的健康软件。
items.py: tā gěi wǒ tuī jiàn le yí gè hěn shí yòng de jiàn kāng ruǎn jiàn
items.en: He recommended a very practical health app to me.
items.why: The new item is 一个 + description + 的 + noun, so 一个很实用的健康软件. 一个的 puts 的 straight after the measure word, which is wrong, and 这个 would make it already known.

items.q: 我有三个___朋友在医院工作。
items.zh: 我有三个朋友在医院工作。
items.py: wǒ yǒu sān gè péng you zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.en: I have three friends who work in a hospital.
items.why: Number + measure word attaches straight to the noun: 三个朋友. 的 never goes after 个; the clause 在医院工作 follows as extra information.

items.q: 请给我一杯___热水。
items.zh: 请给我一杯热水。
items.py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi rè shuǐ
items.en: Please give me a glass of hot water.
items.why: 一杯热水 has no 的 after the measure word 杯. The adjective 热 is a single bare syllable, so no other 的 is needed either.

items.q: 这个___手机是谁的？
items.zh: 这个手机是谁的？
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī shì shéi de
items.en: Whose phone is this?
items.why: 这 + measure word points directly at the noun, so 这个手机 takes no 的. The 的 you do need is in 谁的 at the end.

items.q: 我最近睡不好，想问医生几个___问题。
items.zh: 我最近睡不好，想问医生几个问题。
items.py: wǒ zuì jìn shuì bù hǎo xiǎng wèn yī shēng jǐ gè wèn tí
items.en: I haven't been sleeping well lately and want to ask the doctor a few questions.
items.why: 几个 is a number-type word + measure word and attaches straight to 问题. 的 after 个 is always wrong, and 得 and 地 do not link nouns.

items.q: 那张___照片是我用新手机拍的。
items.zh: 那张照片是我用新手机拍的。
items.py: nà zhāng zhào piān shì wǒ yòng xīn shǒu jī pāi de
items.en: That photo was taken with my new phone.
items.why: 那张 + 照片 is a demonstrative + measure word + noun and needs no 的. 的 would only be possible after a clause, as in 我拍的那张照片.

items.q: 这两个___孩子今天都发烧了。
items.zh: 这两个孩子今天都发烧了。
items.py: zhè liǎng gè hái zi jīn tiān dōu fā shāo le
items.en: These two children both have a fever today.
items.why: 这两个 is a demonstrative + number + measure word, which joins the noun directly. 的 after 个 is the classic error, as in 这两个的孩子.

items.q: 医生给我开了一些___药，说每天饭后吃就行。
items.zh: 医生给我开了一些药，说每天饭后吃就行。
items.py: yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le yī xiē yào shuō měi tiān fàn hòu chī jiù xíng
items.en: The doctor prescribed me some medicine and said to take it after meals every day.
items.why: 一些 works like a measure word, so 药 follows it directly: 一些药. 一些的药 is wrong; a 的 here would have to come after a descriptive phrase, not after 一些.

items.q: 我买了一台___很轻的笔记本电脑，带着上班很方便。
items.zh: 我买了一台很轻的笔记本电脑，带着上班很方便。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le yī tái hěn qīng de bǐ jì běn diàn nǎo dài zhe shàng bān hěn fāng biàn
items.en: I bought a very light laptop; it is convenient to take to work.
items.why: The order is 一台 + 很轻的 + 笔记本电脑. The blank sits after the measure word, so nothing goes there; the 的 belongs after 很轻.

items.zh: 这是医生的手机。
items.py: zhè shì yī shēng de shǒu jī
items.en: This is the doctor's phone.
items.why: Owner + 的 + thing: 医生的手机. The learner has to place 的 between the noun owner and the thing owned, not before 医生 or after 手机.

items.zh: 我奶奶的血压有点高。
items.py: wǒ nǎi nai de xuè yā yǒu diǎn gāo
items.en: My grandmother's blood pressure is a bit high.
items.why: Pronoun + kin takes no 的 (我奶奶), then 的 links the kin to the thing owned (的血压). 有点 stays in front of the adjective 高.

items.zh: 我爸爸的同事推荐的医生很有名。
items.py: wǒ bà ba de tóng shì tuī jiàn de yī shēng hěn yǒu míng
items.en: The doctor my father's colleague recommended is very famous.
items.why: The chain 我爸爸的同事 keeps one 的 before 同事, and the relative clause 同事推荐 takes its own 的 before 医生. The whole phrase sits before the predicate 很有名.

items.zh: 她是一个很细心的护士。
items.py: tā shì yí gè hěn xì xīn de hù shi
items.en: She is a very careful nurse.
items.why: 一个 + 很细心的 + 护士 is the standard shape. 很 + adjective needs 的 before the noun. Putting 很细心的 before 一个 is also heard in speech.

items.zh: 这是我们小区附近最安静的诊所。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ men xiǎo qū fù jìn zuì ān jìng de zhěn suǒ
items.en: This is the quietest clinic near our community.
items.why: 最 + adjective needs 的: 最安静的诊所. The location 我们小区附近 stays in front, and 的 cannot be dropped after 安静.

items.zh: 我昨天拍的照片都丢了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān pāi de zhào piān dōu diū le
items.en: The photos I took yesterday are all lost.
items.why: The clause 我昨天拍 + 的 sits before 照片. The time word 昨天 may come before or after 我, but the clause must stay before the noun it describes.

items.zh: 有很多能帮助你睡好觉的手机软件。
items.py: yǒu hěn duō néng bāng zhù nǐ shuì hǎo jiào de shǒu jī ruǎn jiàn
items.en: There are many phone apps that can help you sleep well.
items.why: The relative clause 能帮助你睡好觉 comes before 手机软件 and ends in 的. There is no 'that', and the clause cannot follow the noun. 有很多 may also close the sentence.

items.zh: 医生开的药很苦。
items.py: yī shēng kāi de yào hěn kǔ
items.en: The medicine the doctor prescribed is very bitter.
items.why: 医生开 + 的 + 药 makes 'the medicine the doctor prescribed', and the whole noun phrase is the subject of 很苦. 的 must come before 药.

items.zh: 这个手机壳是我的。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī ké shì wǒ de
items.en: This phone case is mine.
items.why: 是 + owner + 的 means 'is mine'. The noun is not repeated, but 的 cannot be left out, or the sentence would say the case is me.

items.zh: 我要大的不要小的。
items.py: wǒ yào dà de bú yào xiǎo de
items.en: I want the big one, not the small one.
items.why: Each 的 stands for the missing noun: 大的 and 小的. English adds 'one', but Chinese keeps 的 alone, and 不要 comes before 小的.

items.zh: 包里有穿的也有用的。
items.py: bāo lǐ yǒu chuān de yě yǒu yòng de
items.en: There are things to wear and things to use in the bag.
items.why: 穿的 and 用的 are 'things to wear' and 'things to use'. 的 ends each verb and stands for the unnamed things, so there is no noun after it.

items.zh: 我的两个同事都感冒了。
items.py: wǒ de liǎng gè tóng shì dōu gǎn mào le
items.en: Two of my colleagues both have colds.
items.why: The owner comes first: 我的 + 两个 + 同事. 两个我的同事 is the English-influenced order that Chinese does not use. 都 comes right before the verb.

items.zh: 我昨天买的那个手机壳很好看。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de nà ge shǒu jī ké hěn hǎo kàn
items.en: The phone case I bought yesterday is very nice.
items.why: The clause 我昨天买的 normally comes before 那个 + noun. The reverse order, 那个我昨天买的手机壳, is also correct, but 的 still ends the clause.

items.zh: 医生开了三种药。
items.py: yī shēng kāi le sān zhǒng yào
items.en: The doctor prescribed three kinds of medicine.
items.why: The number + measure word 三种 goes straight before 药 with no 的. 了 follows the verb because the object is counted.

items.zh: 这几个软件我都不会用。
items.py: zhè jǐ gè ruǎn jiàn wǒ dōu bú huì yòng
items.en: I don't know how to use any of these apps.
items.why: 这几个 sits directly before 软件 with no 的. Topic-fronting the object is common, and 我 may come before or after the topic phrase.

items.src: 小王有一个手机。手机很新。
items.src_py: xiǎo wáng yǒu yí gè shǒu jī shǒu jī hěn xīn
items.task: Combine into one sentence: Xiao Wang's phone is new.
items.zh: 小王的手机很新。
items.py: xiǎo wáng de shǒu jī hěn xīn
items.en: Xiao Wang's phone is new.
items.why: Owner + 的 + thing: 小王的手机 becomes the subject, and 很新 follows. Splitting the idea into two sentences is what English 'has a' tempts.

items.src_py: zhè wèi yī shēng hěn yǒu nài xīn
items.task: Say: She is a very patient doctor.
items.zh: 她是一位很有耐心的医生。
items.py: tā shì yī wèi hěn yǒu nài xīn de yī shēng
items.en: She is a very patient doctor.
items.why: The description 很有耐心 needs 的 before the noun 医生. Without it, 很有耐心医生 is wrong. 一位 normally comes before the description.

items.src: 我昨天买手机。手机很好用。
items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi shǒu jī shǒu jī hěn hǎo yòng
items.task: Combine: The phone I bought yesterday is easy to use.
items.zh: 我昨天买的手机很好用。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shǒu jī hěn hǎo yòng
items.en: The phone I bought yesterday is easy to use.
items.why: The first sentence becomes a description of 手机: 我昨天买 + 的 + 手机. There is no word for 'that', and the clause cannot come after the noun.

items.src: 护士给我量了体温。体温有点高。
items.src_py: hù shi gěi wǒ liáng le tǐ wēn tǐ wēn yǒu diǎn gāo
items.task: Combine: The temperature the nurse took for me is a bit high.
items.zh: 护士给我量的体温有点高。
items.py: hù shi gěi wǒ liáng de tǐ wēn yǒu diǎn gāo
items.en: The temperature the nurse took for me is a bit high.
items.why: 护士给我量 becomes a description of 体温 with 的. 了 is left out of the clause, and 有点高 describes the whole phrase.

items.src: 有些人喜欢睡前玩手机。这些人容易失眠。
items.src_py: yǒu xiē rén xǐ huan shuì qián wán shǒu jī zhè xiē rén róng yì shī mián
items.task: Combine: People who like playing on their phone before bed tend to lose sleep.
items.zh: 喜欢睡前玩手机的人容易失眠。
items.py: xǐ huan shuì qián wán shǒu jī de rén róng yì shī mián
items.en: People who like playing on their phone before bed tend to lose sleep.
items.why: 喜欢睡前玩手机 describes 人, and 的 closes it. The clause comes before 人 and is not repeated afterwards.

items.src: 红色的手机是妹妹的手机。
items.src_py: hóng sè de shǒu jī shì mèi mei de shǒu jī
items.zh: 红色的手机是妹妹的。
items.py: hóng sè de shǒu jī shì mèi mei de
items.en: The red phone is my younger sister's.
items.why: The second 手机 is understood, so only 妹妹的 is needed. 的 stays because without it the sentence would equate the phone with the sister.

items.src: 这两个手机壳，我要黑色的手机壳。
items.src_py: zhè liǎng gè shǒu jī ké wǒ yào hēi sè de shǒu jī ké
items.zh: 这两个手机壳，我要黑色的。
items.py: zhè liǎng gè shǒu jī ké wǒ yào hēi sè de
items.en: Of these two phone cases, I want the black one.
items.why: 黑色的 stands for 手机壳, so the second noun is dropped but 的 stays. English 'one' is not added, and 要黑色 alone would sound unfinished.

items.src: 我有两个同事。他们都在医院工作。
items.src_py: wǒ yǒu liǎng gè tóng shì tā men dōu zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.task: Combine: Two of my colleagues both work at a hospital.
items.zh: 我的两个同事都在医院工作。
items.py: wǒ de liǎng gè tóng shì dōu zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.en: Two of my colleagues both work at a hospital.
items.why: The owner comes before the number: 我的两个同事. English 'two of my' cannot be copied, and 的 follows 我 here, not 个.

items.src: 我有一些的问题想问医生。
items.src_py: wǒ yǒu yī xiē de wèn tí xiǎng wèn yī shēng
items.zh: 我有一些问题想问医生。
items.py: wǒ yǒu yī xiē wèn tí xiǎng wèn yī shēng
items.en: I have some questions I want to ask the doctor.
items.why: 一些 is a measure word and takes no 的 before the noun: 一些问题. Adding 的 treats the measure as a description, which Chinese does not do.

items.s_py: nà shì lín jū de ěr jī
items.zh: 那是邻居的耳机。
items.en: That is the neighbour's earphones.
items.why: Owner + 的 + thing: 邻居的耳机. 得 follows a verb or adjective to add a complement and can never link an owner to a noun.
items.py: nà shì lín jū de ěr jī

items.s_py: zhè shì yào wǒ de
items.zh: 这是我的药。
items.en: This is my medicine.
items.why: The owner comes first: 我的药. English 'of mine' order is not used, so 药我的 puts the pieces in the wrong sequence.
items.py: zhè shì wǒ de yào

items.s_py: yī shēng de bàn gōng shì zài èr lóu
items.zh: 医生的办公室在二楼。
items.en: The doctor's office is on the second floor.
items.why: Owner + 的 + thing is correct. 的 is needed because 医生 is a noun owner and 办公室 is a place, not a tight relation.
items.py: yī shēng de bàn gōng shì zài èr lóu

items.s_py: zhè shì wǒ yào nǐ bié chī
items.zh: 这是我的药，你别吃。
items.en: This is my medicine; don't take it.
items.why: Dropping 的 after a pronoun is for family and institutions. 药 is an ordinary thing, so 的 stays: 我的药.
items.py: zhè shì wǒ de yào nǐ bié chī

items.s: 我的妈妈每天早上都在手机上看新闻。
items.s_py: wǒ de mā ma měi tiān zǎo shang dōu zài shǒu jī shàng kàn xīn wén
items.zh: 我的妈妈每天早上都在手机上看新闻。
items.en: My mother reads the news on her phone every morning.
items.why: 我的妈妈 is grammatical, only a little more emphatic than 我妈妈. 的 is optional with kin, not forbidden.
items.py: wǒ de mā ma měi tiān zǎo shang dōu zài shǒu jī shàng kàn xīn wén

items.s_py: zhè shì yī bù hěn guì shǒu jī
items.zh: 这是一部很贵的手机。
items.en: This is a very expensive phone.
items.why: 很贵 is a phrase and must link to the noun with 的: 很贵的手机. Bare 贵手机 would be fine, but 很 + adjective cannot be joined directly.
items.py: zhè shì yī bù hěn guì de shǒu jī

items.s: 她是一位非常有经验医生。
items.s_py: tā shì yī wèi fēi cháng yǒu jīng yàn yī shēng
items.zh: 她是一位非常有经验的医生。
items.en: She is a very experienced doctor.
items.why: A degree word and a multi-syllable description both require 的: 非常有经验的医生. Without it the phrase is incomplete.
items.py: tā shì yī wèi fēi cháng yǒu jīng yàn de yī shēng

items.s_py: tā shì yī wèi hǎo yī shēng
items.zh: 她是一位好医生。
items.en: She is a good doctor.
items.why: 好 is a bare one-syllable adjective, so 好医生 is correct with no 的. Adding 很 would then require 的, but there is no 很 here.
items.py: tā shì yī wèi hǎo yī shēng

items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī bù xīn shǒu jī
items.zh: 我想买一部新手机。
items.en: I want to buy a new phone.
items.why: 新 is a bare one-syllable adjective and joins the noun directly. Learners often add 的, but 新手机 is the plain, tight pairing.
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī bù xīn shǒu jī

items.s: 经常熬夜人的容易头疼。
items.s_py: jīng cháng áo yè rén de róng yì tóu téng
items.zh: 经常熬夜的人容易头疼。
items.en: People who often stay up late get headaches easily.
items.why: 的 must close the clause 经常熬夜 before the noun 人. Putting it after 人 would make 人的 a possessor, and 容易头疼 has no subject.
items.py: jīng cháng áo yè de rén róng yì tóu téng

items.s: 我昨天在网上订的那台电脑今天就到了。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng dìng de nà tái diàn nǎo jīn tiān jiù dào le
items.zh: 我昨天在网上订的那台电脑今天就到了。
items.en: The computer I ordered online yesterday has already arrived today.
items.why: The clause + 的 + 那台 + noun order is correct. The finished action 订 takes no 了 inside the clause, and 的 does not follow 台.
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng dìng de nà tái diàn nǎo jīn tiān jiù dào le

items.s_py: zhè ge chōng diàn qì shì shuí
items.zh: 这个充电器是谁的？
items.en: Whose charger is this?
items.why: 'Whose' is 谁的, and 的 stays even though 充电器 is in the sentence already. 是谁 would ask who the charger is.

items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng yào dà de hái shì xiǎo de
items.zh: 你想要大的还是小的？
items.en: Do you want the big one or the small one?
items.why: 大的 and 小的 are correct: 的 stands for the missing noun. No word for 'one' is needed, and 的 cannot be dropped in either half.

items.s: 这个手机壳是我昨天买的，不是朋友送的。
items.s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī ké shì wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de bú shì péng you sòng de
items.zh: 这个手机壳是我昨天买的，不是朋友送的。
items.en: This phone case is one I bought yesterday, not one a friend gave me.
items.why: 买的 and 送的 are clauses with no noun, so 的 ends each one. The noun is understood from 手机壳, and nothing needs to be added.
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī ké shì wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de bú shì péng you sòng de

items.s: 我有一个很会修手机的朋友。
items.s_py: wǒ yǒu yí gè hěn huì xiū shǒu jī de péng you
items.zh: 我有一个很会修手机的朋友。
items.en: I have a friend who is very good at fixing phones.
items.why: 一个 comes before the long description, which ends in 的 right before 朋友. This is the standard order for introducing someone new.
items.py: wǒ yǒu yí gè hěn huì xiū shǒu jī de péng you

items.s_py: zhè wèi de yī shēng hěn yǒu míng
items.zh: 这位医生很有名。
items.en: This doctor is very famous.
items.why: 这位 is a demonstrative + measure word and joins the noun directly. 的 after a measure word is always wrong.

items.s: 医生给我开了一些的药。
items.s_py: yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le yī xiē de yào
items.zh: 医生给我开了一些药。
items.en: The doctor prescribed me some medicine.
items.why: 一些 works like a measure word, so 药 follows directly. A 的 after 一些 is not allowed.
items.py: yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le yī xiē yào

items.s: 这是一份三个月的健身计划。
items.s_py: zhè shì yī fèn sān gè yuè de jiàn shēn jì huà
items.zh: 这是一份三个月的健身计划。
items.en: This is a three-month fitness plan.
items.why: 三个月的 describes the kind of plan, so 的 is correct. It sits after 三个月, not after the measure word 份, which stays directly before 三个月.
